---
title: "Resonator meander"
sidebar: get-started
---

`resonator_meander` creates a meandering CPW body. Its `length` applies to the
meander body alone; a parent resonator accounts for hanger, tail, and optional
qubit-segment geometry separately.

## Build the default component

```python
import gdsfactory as gf
from orcapen_sc_pdk import activate

activate()
component = gf.get_component("resonator_meander")
```

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | 4000 µm | Meander body centerline target. |
| `meanders` | 6 | Number of meander turns. |
| `bend_spec` | `bend_euler` | Bend component specification. |
| `cpw_xs` | `cpw_6_10_6` | CPW cross-section. |
| `cpw_radius` | 100 µm | Bend radius. |
| `open_start`, `open_end` | `False`, `False` | Whether to leave the corresponding end open. |

## Ports and layers

The default component exposes route ports `o1` and `o2`; straight sections can
also expose mesh ports. DRAW, ETCH, and GROUND_MASK layers are configurable.

See the [generated API reference](../../reference/cells.resonator_meander.qmd#orcapen_sc_pdk.cells.resonator_meander)
and [pinned public source](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/0bd9a9e1e8e21d6519f22373f20ef5ce22772a5b/orcapen_sc_pdk/cells/layout/resonator_meander.py).
